summary.text: Marc Joseph Sosnowski is the U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate on the November ballot for Michigan's 12th District. A Detroit native with a background in property management and sales, he has run in several earlier local, university-board and congressional races.

paragraphs.text: Born in Detroit; graduated from Detroit Catholic Central High School.
Earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Michigan-Dearborn (1978) and a graduate degree from Cornerstone University (2009).

Career experience includes work as a business consultant and in sales, property management, insurance, environmental testing and bio-ethics; Ballotpedia lists him as affiliated with the U.S. Taxpayers Party, Right to Life, Lifespan and the Knights of Columbus.

Ran unsuccessfully for the Wayne State University Board of Governors in 2018 and 2022, for Wayne County Commission District 8 in 2020 and 2024, and for U.S. House in the 2018 special election in Michigan's 13th District.
Nominated at the U.S. Taxpayers Party convention on July 18, 2026.
